signIn.title: Welcome back

errors.invalidCredentials: That email or password is not correct.
errors.emailNotVerified: Confirm your email address first. Check your inbox for the link.

errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

validation.passwordsDoNotMatch: The two passwords do not match.

emailVerified.title: Email confirmed

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Pick something you have not used elsewhere.
resetPassword.sessionsNote: Signing in again is required afterwards, because every other device is signed out when a password changes.
resetPassword.invalidBody: Password reset links work once and expire after an hour. Request a new one to continue.
